page_title: UDI 2-3 INT | Udinese v Inter 28/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+4' Inter have a goal ruled out for offside!
90+3' Inter quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.

90+2' Joaquin Correa (Inter) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went straight towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save. Inter get a corner.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Inter are seeing far more of the ball now.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Joaquin Correa (Inter) comes onto the pitch for Lautaro Martinez.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Iker Bravo (Udinese) is coming onto the pitch as Oier Zarraga cannot continue after picking up an injury.
85' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Davide Frattesi will be replaced by Piotr Zielinski (Inter).
83' 2 - 3 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
82' The current number of shots on goal is 2:6.
80' The Udinese players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
77' Inter enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
75' Substitution. Alessandro Bastoni is replaced by Stefan de Vrij (Inter).
75' The game has come to an end for Marcus Thuram. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Mehdi Taremi (Inter).
74' The manager makes a subsitution with Brenner (Udinese) coming on for Florian Thauvin.
74' Here is a change. Jesper Karlstrom is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Arthur Atta (Udinese).
72' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Udinese.
72' Udinese spell of possession comes to an end after a mistake.
67' The Inter players are exchanging some short passes.
65' It will be a substitution. Carlos Augusto (Inter) is ready to enter the pitch as Federico Dimarco walks off.
63' Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
61' Federico Dimarco (Inter) knocks his opponent down with an over-the-top tackle. Udinese earn a free kick.
60' Udinese win a corner.
60' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Udinese comes to nothing. The ball goes behind for a corner. Udinese will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Kosta Runjaic has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) replacing Keinan Davis.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Sandi Lovric walks off the pitch to be replaced by Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese).
55' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Inter.
54' It's a nice effort by Christian Kabasele (Udinese) from the edge of the box, but it's low towards the middle of the goal and straight down the throat of Yann Sommer. Easy save.
51' Referee Juan Luca Sacchi sees the trip by Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
50' Inter have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

47' 1 - 3 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Lautaro Martinez (Inter). Marcus Thuram plays a fantastic through ball and finds Lautaro Martinez (Inter), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the left side of the goal. It's now 1:3.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Juan Luca Sacchi sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
45+5' Wait! Referee Juan Luca Sacchi has indicated he is going to review the Inter goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+3' 1 - 2 Goal! A great through ball by Federico Dimarco sets up Lautaro Martinez (Inter) inside the box, and he makes no mistake and bangs the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:2.
45+2' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Florian Thauvin (Udinese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
43' Matteo Darmian (Inter) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 1:3.
38' Federico Dimarco (Inter) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
35' 1 - 1 Christian Kabasele (Udinese) scores from a quite difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header low inside the left post. Excellent finish.
34' Udinese take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

34' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play and Udinese have been awarded a corner kick.

32' Davide Frattesi (Inter) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
32' Inter seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

28' A sweet pass inside the box gives Davide Frattesi (Inter) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Udinese.
26' Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
25' Udinese take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
23' A pass by Federico Dimarco (Inter) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Udinese will have a goal kick.
22' 33:67 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
20' Great teamplay by Inter as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
16' Jaka Bijol (Udinese) commits a rough challenge and Juan Luca Sacchi blows his whistle for an infringement.
13' Federico Dimarco (Inter) will take a corner kick.
13' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
11' Udinese control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
8' Looks like Sandi Lovric (Udinese) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
5' Neat passing move from Udinese in order to create new attacking opportunities.
1' 0 - 1 Davide Frattesi (Inter) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
1' The first half has started.
Inter will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Juan Luca Sacchi.
